name: A paged, filterable debug window
body: Dean (2026-11-17): a better debug window where he can filter through pages of debug values, organised neatly and navigatable. Today F1 is one long panel: the Audio underrun line sits off the bottom of the screen and the panel overlaps the pause menu (known cosmetic bug).
details: Outcome (2026-11-17): DebugWindow with pages, filter, keyboard and mouse navigation, scrolling; F3 focuses it (F2 is the collision view). Audio page shows underruns and the buses. See docs/debug-window.md and D-180, D-181. 266 of 266 tests pass.
plan: Replace DebugHud with DebugWindow: values grouped into pages (Frame, Audio, Renderer, Camera, Player, Companion, World, Other) plus an All page, a type-to-filter box, Tab or Left/Right and the mouse for pages, wheel/Up/Down/PageUp/PageDown for scrolling, a scrollbar, and a size that fits the window. It draws under the pause menu, not over it. Subsystems register values with a page by path prefix (`Page/Name`); an unlisted group gets its own page. Audio page shows underruns and bus levels.
acceptance_criteria: Pages by area, switchable by keyboard and mouse
A text filter narrows the values shown, across pages
Long pages scroll and the window fits any window size
The audio page shows underruns, queued time and voices
The window does not overlap the pause menu
definition_of_done: Tests added and `mist run test` passes
Screenshots posted to the project chat
